zh-CN.title: 顶栏未覆盖到内容边界
zh-CN.symptom: 原生顶栏高度与内容起点不一致，或隐藏缓存页面被当作几何参考。
zh-CN.action: 按精确客户端适配检查可见且非零的参考边界；只延伸自有背景层，保留按钮和拖动区域。
zh-CN.verify: 核对普通/最大化及当前绘制分支的实际覆盖，不能只看选择器命中。

en.title: Topbar coverage gap
en.symptom: Native bar height differs from the content boundary, or hidden cached pages supply geometry.
en.action: Use visible nonzero references from the exact client profile. Extend only the owned paint layer; preserve native buttons and dragging.
en.verify: Check actual normal/maximized coverage for the active paint branch, not just selector matches.

zh-CN.title: 原生页脚遮挡底图
zh-CN.symptom: 源图下方清晰，但聊天页脚伪元素另绘渐变和黑底。
zh-CN.action: 比较源图与页脚before/after样式；仅清除已证实的聊天区域装饰底色，不用扩图或模糊补边掩盖。
zh-CN.verify: 普通/最大化检查伪元素透明且地面连续，保留输入框和附件点击。

en.title: Native footer hides the scene
en.symptom: The source is sharp but footer pseudo-elements add their own gradient and solid fill.
en.action: Compare source art and computed before/after styles. Clear proven chat decoration fills only; do not mask the cause with outpainting.
en.verify: Check continuous ground and transparent pseudo-elements at both window sizes; retain composer and attachment hits.

zh-CN.title: 弹层内层底板盖住主题色
zh-CN.symptom: 外层已着色，但原生内层组件或伪元素仍绘制自己的底色。
zh-CN.action: 定位实际可见内层及其表面变量；局部适配并保留差异、状态等语义颜色，禁止全局后代改色。
zh-CN.verify: 重新打开原生弹层，检查真实底板和普通文字/图标对比度。

en.title: Inner popover backplate hides theme paint
en.symptom: An inner native component can retain its own fill after the outer container is themed.
en.action: Inspect the visible inner component and surface variables. Scope changes and preserve semantic colors; avoid universal descendant overrides.
en.verify: Reopen the native popover and inspect actual neutral text/icon contrast on its visible surface.

zh-CN.title: 客户端版本与适配不匹配
zh-CN.symptom: 客户端更新后旧助手仍存在，不代表旧配置适用于新界面。
zh-CN.action: 核对实际客户端、所选配置和兼容下限。下限起复用基线，出现界面差异时为该版本添加精确配置。
zh-CN.verify: 检查官方会话版本、选中的适配和实际界面一致；旧盘点不能改版本号后复用。

en.title: Client/profile version mismatch
en.symptom: A surviving helper after an app update does not establish profile compatibility.
en.action: Check the actual client, selected profile and minimum version. Add an exact profile for a release whose surfaces differ from the baseline.
en.verify: Verify official session, chosen profile and actual surfaces. Do not relabel old inventory as new-version evidence.

zh-CN.title: 代码更新但窗口仍用旧载荷
zh-CN.symptom: 助手在启动时读取载荷，文件同步本身不会证明当前窗口已加载新版本。
zh-CN.action: 比较包内载荷版本和受管状态；按精确身份正常停止并重载唯一自有助手，保留客户端，不并行启动第二个助手。
zh-CN.verify: 核对实际注入版本与活动主题；临时预览不能代替正式主题的保存和透明度检查。

en.title: Window still uses an older payload
en.symptom: The companion reads its payload at startup; copied files alone do not prove a live update.
en.action: Compare payload metadata with managed status. Reload only the uniquely verified owned companion, preserving the client and avoiding a second watcher.
en.verify: Check the live revision and active Skin. A temporary preview does not verify saved theme or opacity settings.

zh-CN.title: 错误的PowerShell宿主导致身份校验差异
zh-CN.symptom: 较新宿主可能自动解析JSON日期，改变字符串精度，令原时间戳比较拒绝。
zh-CN.action: 按原启动链路使用Windows PowerShell的powershell.exe；先核实实际进程身份，不能改时间戳或放宽比较。
zh-CN.verify: 原身份校验必须在指定宿主真正通过，不能把换解释器当作绕过条件。

en.title: PowerShell host changes timestamp parsing
en.symptom: A newer host may parse JSON dates automatically and alter precision used by the legacy identity check.
en.action: Use Windows PowerShell powershell.exe for that route. Verify process identity; never edit timestamps or relax comparisons.
en.verify: The original owner check must genuinely pass in its supported host; changing interpreters is not an identity bypass.

zh-CN.title: 新增导入与打包契约不同步
zh-CN.symptom: 渲染器新增核心函数导入，但载荷构建器的精确导入头未同步。
zh-CN.action: 同步已审查依赖的精确导入声明，保留未知模块拒绝；不要改成宽泛字符串删除以让构建通过。
zh-CN.verify: 构建完成后核对载荷解析、未知目标拒绝和独立包依赖隔离。

en.title: Payload dependency header mismatch
en.symptom: A renderer import was added without updating the payload builder strict import header.
en.action: Update the exact reviewed import contract. Preserve unknown-module rejection instead of broad import stripping.
en.verify: Verify payload parsing, foreign-target refusal and standalone dependency isolation after rebuilding.

zh-CN.title: 原生搜索上下文异常，原因未定
zh-CN.symptom: 曾出现原生线程上下文错误；重试恢复且后续未复现，根因仍未证实。
zh-CN.action: 保留观察并使用已显示的原生重试恢复；需要隔离时只移除自有层，不清账户数据、不放宽错误页注入条件。
zh-CN.verify: 区分原生/有皮肤对照和可能重放的旧日志。一次重试成功不能登记根因已修复。

en.title: Native search context error; cause unresolved
en.symptom: A native thread-context error recovered on retry and did not recur in later comparisons; its cause is unconfirmed.
en.action: Retain observations and use the visible native retry. If isolation is needed, remove only owned layers; keep account data and error-page guards.
en.verify: Distinguish native/themed comparisons from replayed old logs. One successful retry does not establish a root-cause fix.
